sentences.en: I was quite pleased with myself for managing a joke.
sentences.zh: 我很为自己能讲个笑话而感到满意。

sentences.en: Kaya was rather adroit at managing conflicts between her employees.
sentences.zh: 卡雅在处理员工之间的冲突方面相当熟练。

sentences.en: This is the first time that I am managing a company.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次管理一家公司。

senses.zh: 管理的，节约的v.使用( manage的现在分词 ),完成（困难的事）,经营,明智地使用（金钱、时间、信息等）
